body.statement: There exist universal constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) such that for every sequence with \(d_n\to\infty\), \(d_n=o(\sqrt n)\), and \(nd_n\) even, \[\Pr_{G_n}\!\left\{c\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\le R_2(G_n)\le C\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\right\}\longrightarrow1.\] On the same graph event, the design-estimator returned by \(\mathsf{Compile}(G_n)\) has worst-case design MSE at most \(C\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\) over exactly \(\mathcal M(G_n,\tau_{\mathrm{GATE}},2)\).
body.justification: This field-tier closure identifies the universal risk scale and certifies an attaining one-shot procedure against the unrestricted Kandiros--Harshaw--S\'{a}vje benchmark.
body.gap: KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax Corollary 5.4 leaves a factor \(d_n\) on the identical game; the inherited version-one infrastructure narrows this to a logarithmic gap, and the sole new root-level four-root estimate closes that remaining gap.
body.consumer: KarrerEtAl2021Scale can use the theorem to determine whether the deployed cluster-randomized \(d_n^2/n\) benchmark is rate-optimal in the diffuse regular-network regime and how required population size grows with degree.
